description: This file defines API endpoints for managing credentials, including creating, listing, retrieving details, updating, and deleting credentials. It uses FastAPI for routing, Pydantic models for validation, and interacts with a credential service for data operations.

classes.name: CredentialCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new credential, requiring a title and content.

classes.name: CredentialUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating credential content.

classes.name: CredentialOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for publicly exposing credential ID and title.

classes.name: CredentialDetailOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for returning full credential details including content.

methods.name: create_credential(payload: CredentialCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new encrypted credential, returning its minimal info.

methods.name: list_credentials(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to list all credentials for the current user without content details.

methods.name: get_credential(cred_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve detailed, decrypted content of a specific credential.

methods.name: update_credential( cred_id: int, payload: CredentialUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update the content of an existing credential.

methods.name: delete_credential(cred_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a specific credential.
